purpose: A room-specific Uplink lower-half environment plate that embeds the side-entry Wound threshold into the cavern, deck, rock, frost, and machinery instead of placing a separate portal sprite over the room.

generation.method: built-in image generation with precise-object environment edits
generation.lockedPromptSummary: Preserve the mirrored Uplink plate while rebuilding its lower third and right boundary as one continuous 16-bit cavern-and-machinery environment, with a narrow side-entry blue-violet Wound membrane embedded at the far-right deck edge and a small bolted DANGER / ACTIVE WORK placard mounted above it.
generation.openPromptSummary: Change only the embedded membrane to a restrained dark traversable recess while preserving the permanent rock-integrated rim, deck, pipes, crystals, palette, and all unrelated room pixels.
generation.rendering: nearest-neighbor source normalization; the generated placard is baked into the shared locked base; the open runtime is composited locally through the doorway interior mask so every pixel outside the membrane remains identical

placement.environmentTreatment: The full lower-half plate carries the main deck, lower-third terrain, cavern-rock transition, machinery, right wall, and Wound opening as one authored image.

worksiteSign.treatment: A small weathered amber-red metal placard with warm block-pixel lettering, corner bolts, and a slight physical cant.
worksiteSign.placement: Baked into the pipe-and-rock structure directly above the far-right side-entry threshold.
worksiteSign.stateContinuity: Identical in locked, opening, and open states; it is environmental storytelling, never floating UI.

runtimeThreshold.collision: Locked contact stops Aryn at the generated membrane's visible left edge; passage remains blocked until the localized open-state blend is at least 94 percent complete.
runtimeThreshold.occlusion: The far-right 92-pixel environment slice is replayed after Aryn so she disappears into the authored wall before the Wound descent begins.
runtimeThreshold.progressLanguage: The standard HUD, mission line, and unlock announcement communicate requirements; the threshold itself remains environmental rather than becoming a status panel.
runtimeThreshold.label: The permanent floating label remains retired; the Uplink room eyebrow and one-time unlock announcement carry location and state.

states.locked: A restrained blue-violet membrane is recessed into a narrow rock-and-machinery opening at the far-right deck edge.
states.opening: Only the doorway interior blends over 0.72 seconds; every environment pixel outside the membrane remains fixed.
states.open: The membrane resolves to a dark navy side passage while the rock-integrated rim, deck, pipes, crystals, and wall remain unchanged.

archivedExperiments.isolatedSideLock: retired before commit; no runtime asset retained
archivedExperiments.reason: Both separate-sprite treatments were visually abrupt against the Uplink plate and are no longer loaded by the runtime.

replaces: the freestanding front-facing gate, the isolated reinforced side-lock sprite, the clean concrete boundary slab, and all runtime-drawn gate framing
